title: Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1982-09-15
lineage: CDR > EAC > WavMerge > Soundforge (on d2t12) > CD-Wave > TLH v.1.0.0.72 (for SBE-OK, FLAC compression, and checksums) > FLAC
source: "Recorded by Tiger Rose, FOB Nak shotgun mics > Sony TC-D5. MAC > CD Analog to Digital transfer by David Howard."

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear audience FOB that captures a high‑energy late‑'82 show with smoking Crazy Fingers, Playing in the Band and the first Touch of Grey.
ai_review.review: The recording is consistently praised as one of the best early‑80s audience tapes – “on‑stage” sounding mics, vivid ambience and superb clarity.  Musically the concert delivers a blazing first set (Crazy Fingers, Playin’, Shakedown) and a jam‑rich second set with standout moments like Sailor/Saint, Not Fade Away and the historic Touch of Grey encore.

ai_rating.rationale: All nine reviews are strongly positive about both the performance and the sound quality; the show is described as high‑energy with several standout songs, while the recording is called excellent or best of the era.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners note crystal‑clear, on‑stage mic capture; described as the best early‑80s FOB with no noticeable dropouts or muffiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, tightly‑woven first set followed by a jam‑heavy second set that builds smoothly into NFA and finishes with an emotional Touch of Grey encore.

band_member_comments.Drums: Drums praised early in the show; one reviewer felt the post‑drum portion was only average.
